summary.text: Debra Lekanoff is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 40-Position 1 since January 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Cindy Carter.

paragraphs.text: Debra Lekanoff earned a bachelor's degree from Central Washington University in 2000 and attended Evergreen College for a master's degree.
